help.title: 🃏 TookBot cards guide
help.intro: Collect, fuse, customize and trade cards of your favorite characters! Here is everything you can do.
help.get_value:
**/roll `[universe]`** — pull a random card (cooldown **1h**, **30 min on the support server**). Every roll grants **Essences ✨** (the rarer the card, the more you get; duplicate = ×2).
**/daily** — daily reward (Essences + TookCoins + streak).
**Drop Events** — cards appear in some channels: type the **code shown on the image** to win it (first come, first served).
help.essences_value:
**/essences** — your balance. **/cardshop** — buy cards & cosmetics.
**/cardrecycle `<card>`** — turn your duplicates into Essences (you always keep 1 copy).
help.fusion_value:
**/cardfuse `<card>`** — consume copies of the same card to add a **star** to it (up to 5). Rising cost: 2 → 3 → 4 → 5 → 6 copies. A fused card becomes **untradeable** (recycling only).
**/cardup `<rarity>`** — sacrifice duplicates of **5⭐** cards for 1 random card of the **rarity above**.
help.cosmetics_value:
**/cardcustom `<card>` `<border>`** — apply a border (bought in the shop, consumed on use). **/cardinventory** — your cosmetics in stock.
**/show `<card>`** — show a card with its border and its stars.
help.profile_value: **/cardprofile `[member]`** — stats, **combat power** and an image of your 3 featured cards. **/cardprofile `custom:true`** — editor: pick your 3 featured cards + your profile color. **/cardtop `<category>`** — leaderboards.
help.combat_value: Your cards have a **combat power** (HP + ATK ×2, fusion bonus). **Bosses** appear in the cards channel: everyone hits to deal damage, and the **loot** (essences + rolls) is shared between the participants on victory.
help.trade_value:
**/cardwish `<card>`** — wishlist (3 max, **6 on the support server**): you get pinged when someone pulls it. **/cardwishlist** — view/remove. **/cardtrade `<player>`** — multi-card trade.
**/cardsuggest** — suggest a character (🔼/🔽 community vote). **/cardmodify `<card>`** — suggest an edit to an existing card.
help.guild_value:
**/guild create `<name>`** — found a club (up to 30 members, max lvl 60). The guild earns XP through rolls / bosses / wheel / fusions / donations and unlocks **passive bonuses**: % essences, % XP, reduced roll cooldown, +roll/h, wishlist, boss loot, guild bank & shop.
**/guildprofile `[name]`** — full sheet. **/guild top** — leaderboard. **/guild info / invite / accept / leave / donate ...**
help.footer: Tip: join the support server for 2 rolls/h and 6 wishes!
